bio.text: Michael Crawford has represented the 31st District in the Illinois House of Representatives since January 2025.
The legislature biography describes him as a postsecondary educator and administrator who was born and raised in Chicago and graduated from Lane Technical High School.
He holds a B.S. and M.S.Ed. from Northern Illinois University, an MBA from Saint Xavier University, and a Ph.D. from Concordia University Chicago.
